result.reason: 2 findings, both nits and none important, and 3 dropped.

findings.label: N3
findings.problem: StopsService.removeStops removes the stops one at a time with day.removeStops([stop]). If the list names the same stop twice, the second removal fails, because the stop has already left its day. The error then says "These stops aren't on the day: <stop>", but the stop was on the day. The real problem is that it was named twice.
findings.failure_case: The coordinator calls remove-stops with [dinner, dinner]. The write fails with "These stops aren't on the day: dinner (stop_x)." and nothing is removed, even though dinner is on that day.
findings.label_reason: The call does fail, so the agent knows to act. Only the reason in the message is wrong, which is N3, not F1 or F2. The change added this code, so it's a nit.

findings.label: N3
findings.problem: refuseRejectedPlaces joins every rejected name into one sentence but always says "so it can't be a candidate". With two or more places the sentence reads as if it were about one.
findings.failure_case: An offer set holds two rejected places, A and B. The message reads "The user rejected A, B, so it can't be a candidate. No candidates were added."
findings.label_reason: The text an agent reads is unclear but not false, since it still names the right places and says nothing was added. So it's N3 and not F2. The change added this code.

dropped.problem: The weather label compares date.compareTo(today) <= FORECAST_DAYS. That would always be true if compareTo returned only -1, 0 or 1.
dropped.label: D1
dropped.reason: CalendarDate.compareTo returns the number of days between the two dates (calendar-date.ts line 99). So the 7-day comparison is right. The test checks both sides of the cutoff.

dropped.problem: The diff removes the started-trip guard from TripRepository.save, so a started trip could be saved.
dropped.label: D1
dropped.reason: The only caller of TripRepository.save outside tests is TripWriter.#writeOnce. It calls #refuseIfStarted right before save, using the start date and place as loaded.

dropped.problem: moveStop could leave a stop on two days, or half moved, if a later step throws.
dropped.label: D1
dropped.reason: placeStops checks `after` before it changes anything, and the other steps can't throw after it. Any throw also rolls back the whole write transaction in TripWriter, so nothing half-moved is saved.
